inlines.v: PUN'GENT, adjective [Latin pungens, pungo.] Pricking; stimulating; as pungent snuff. The pungent grains of titillating dust. 1. Acrid; affecting the tongue like small sharp points; as the sharp and pungent taste of acids. 2. Piercing; sharp; as pungent pains; pungent grief. 3. Acrimonious; biting.
